experiment_template.baseline_ref: exact round-three instrument; historical failure replay only
experiment_template.research_question: Measured oversized-output deferral enables recovery without false source-delivery credit.
stop_conditions: No changed effects or automatic tool replay.
No false first-delivery or native credit.
No live run before exact freeze.

success_criteria.live: Separate matched H1 protocol and exact freeze required

records.falsifier: Any withheld source is credited, mutation outcome changes, or known oversized responses cannot yield actionable bounded feedback.
records.mechanism: Try complete fresh delivery before bounded truthful read-only deferral; the model requests smaller pages through existing tools.
records.scope: Candidate small-window instrument research; no live successor freeze or general model claim.
records.statement: Measured oversized-output deferral enables recovery without false source-delivery credit.

records.claim: Seventeen deferral notices were delivered across both arms; all 16 cells completed with zero context-budget stops and 13 native scores. Withheld source received no automatic score credit under the frozen exporter.
limitations: A fitting notice does not prove useful semantic recovery or lower token use.
Round three versus round four is not a randomized causal comparison.

records.next_action: Retain truthful deferral as a common development instrument, preserve its claim ceiling, and test terminal submission separately; revisit or specialize if later runs show retry loops or token cost without outcome benefit.

claim_ceiling: Narrow instrument evidence; no isolated H7 causal efficacy or benchmark claim.
